title: Groove
description: Revolver, Abbey Road, Rubber Soul, Sgt. Pepper and Let It Be pressed into black records, the cover living only in the grooves and printed on the label with the real side-one tracks. Spin it under the lamp and the sleeve surfaces in the sheen, then sinks back into black.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge on real records: the cover is encoded only as groove orientation, so it exists purely as anisotropic specular light and appears wherever the lamp's lobe falls.
